{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter for SEVERE disease
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Step 2: Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_severe_clean = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_severe_dedup = df_severe_clean.loc[df_severe_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 4: Compute mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = df_severe_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Number of severe patients after deduplication: {len(df_severe_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL) among severe patients: {mean_baseline_severe}")"}
